newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE nearby canola ends down on long liquidation.
newsitem.headline: WCE nearby canola ends down on long liquidation.

text.p: WCE nearby canola futures ended lower on commercial long liquidation, traders said.

"July long liquidation brought us down despite funds rolling out of their July positions, there were hedges in the July and Nov. Exporters bought on the close," a trader said. July WCE futures crush margin rose to -0.02 Thursday from -1.69 Wednesday. About 800 July-Nov spread at $32.50, 450 July-Aug from $0.50, Nov-Jan at $3.50. Volume was 4,376 lots.
Japan bought 10,000 tonnes of canola overnight on the cash market, sources said.
July canola fell $0.80 to close at $395.40 and November settled up $0.40 at $363.60. July flax closed up $1.60 to $334.50 on European demand.
July-Nov flax spread at $23. Volume was 300 lots.
Barley and July feed wheat set new contract lows on good growing weather and nearby liquidation, traders said.
Alberta Wheat Pool sold July western barley down $0.30 to a new low of $127.70 to commercials, RBC-DS sold October down $0.90 at $130.20, a trader said. AWP sold July-Oct at $3.
July feed wheat lost $1.20 to a new low of $152.80 on long liquidation, October fell $1.20 to $156.30. PCTS sold July-Oct spread at $3.50, AWP offered July-Dec at $3.50, a trader said.
LFG sold October feed pea contracts up US$0.50 at US$178 to RBC-DS. Louis Dreyfus bought Oct-May at $1.50.
PCTS sold 10 October oat down US$0.30 to US$106.70 to UGG.
(All prices in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats, peas).
